design: Two conditions x two independent phases. Four fresh model responses. No tools requested.
equal_information: Both conditions receive every original message and the same later corrections. The baseline is not intentionally weakened.
initial_checks: branch exploration is not merged automatically
local shortening is not a permanent preference
patch is not verified while reproduction fails
update_checks: the engineering guide is discussion only
CSV success does not verify all formats
limitations: One response per condition and phase; no statistical inference.
Understanding entries were coordinator-written, not autonomously extracted.
History transport uses a labeled fictional adapter, not live Codex chats.
This is a component-level response comparison, not a GUI onboarding or native-memory benchmark.
No claim about total feedback reduction or token savings.
